name: CreateProhibitedPolicy

parameters.help_en: Policy Name of the software ban policy. Policy Name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported
parameters.help_zh: 软件禁用策略名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不支持空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the software ban policy. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can be left empty
parameters.help_zh: 软件禁用策略描述。长度不超过128个字符，允许为空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The action to take. Valid values:

Ban: Blocks the software from running and displays a pop-up notification to the end user.
BanSilent: Blocks the software from running without notifying the end user (silent blocking).
Warn: Displays a pop-up notification to the end user without blocking the software from running
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作。取值：
Ban：禁止运行并在终端弹窗提醒终端用户。
BanSilent：禁止运行且不提醒终端用户，静默阻断。
Warn：仅在终端弹窗提醒终端用户，不阻断软件运行
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:
true: Enabled. The policy is delivered to the endpoint and takes effect.
false: Disabled. The policy configuration is retained but not delivered to the endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
策略是否启用。取值：
true：启用，策略会下发到终端并生效。
false：停用，策略保留配置但不下发到终端
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The list of exempted usernames
parameters.help_zh: 例外用户名列表
parameters.name: whitelist

parameters.help_en: The Chinese prompt content displayed in the pop-up window on the endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 终端弹窗的中文提示内容
parameters.name: prompt_ch

parameters.help_en: The English prompt content displayed in the pop-up window on the endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 终端弹窗的英文提示内容
parameters.name: prompt_en

parameters.help_en: The policy priority. Valid values: 0 to 99. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 策略优先级。取值范围：0~99，数值越小优先级越高
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The object type. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
管控对象类型。取值：
App：按禁用软件管控，管控对象由SoftwareIds指定。
Tag：按禁用软件标签管控，管控对象由TagIds指定，标签内的全部禁用软件均被管控
parameters.name: object_type

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the blocked software is a built-in blocked software entry. Valid values:
true: A built-in blocked software entry that is shared across all Alibaba Cloud accounts. Built-in entries cannot be modified or deleted.
false: A custom blocked software entry under the current Alibaba Cloud account
fields.help_zh:
该禁用软件是否为系统内置禁用软件。取值：
true：系统内置禁用软件，所有阿里云账号共享，不支持修改和删除。
false：当前阿里云账号下的自定义禁用软件
fields.name: is_default

fields.help_en:
The ID of the prohibited software. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~): Lists prohibited software.
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~): Creates custom prohibited software
fields.help_zh:
禁用软件ID。取值来源：
[ListProhibitedSoftware](~~ListProhibitedSoftware~~)：批量查询禁用软件。
[CreateProhibitedSoftware](~~CreateProhibitedSoftware~~)：创建自定义禁用软件
fields.name: software_id

parameters.help_en: The collection of banned software directly controlled by this policy
parameters.help_zh: 该策略直接管控的禁用软件集合
parameters.name: software_ids

parameters.help_en: The collection of banned software tag IDs controlled by this policy
parameters.help_zh: 该策略管控的禁用软件标签ID集合
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en: The scope in which the policy takes effect. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
生效范围。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效，不需要指定用户组。
UserGroupNormal：仅对UserGroupIds指定的用户组内的用户生效
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en: The collection of user group IDs for which the policy takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 策略生效的用户组ID集合
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether end users are allowed to submit a report request for this policy. Valid values:

true: Reporting is allowed. The pop-up window on the endpoint provides a reporting entry.
false: Reporting is not allowed
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许终端用户对该策略发起报备申请。取值：
true：允许报备，终端弹窗提供报备入口。
false：不允许报备
parameters.name: allow_report

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcefully terminate running software processes. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制结束已运行的软件进程。取值：
true：终端在命中策略时立即结束该软件正在运行的进程。
false：不结束已运行的进程，仅阻止后续启动
parameters.name: force_kill

parameters.help_zh: 终端弹窗的中文标题

Description.description_en: The description of the software prohibition policy

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the policy is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled. The policy is delivered to the endpoint and takes effect.
false: Disabled. The policy retains its configuration but is not delivered to the endpoint
Enabled.description_zh:
策略是否启用。取值：

ForceKill.description_en:
Specifies whether to forcibly terminate running software processes. Valid values:
true: The terminal immediately terminates the running process of the software when the policy is hit.
false: Running processes are not terminated. Only subsequent launches are blocked

是否强制结束已运行的软件进程。取值：
true：终端在命中策略时立即结束该软件正在运行的进程。
false：不结束已运行的进程，仅阻止后续启动
